clue.text: Screenplays require crisp editing, time and direction

indicators.note: editing reworks text, so the word crisp is rearranged

parts.note: S, for south, is a compass direction

explanation.surface: Writing film scripts needs sharp revision, enough time and good direction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'direction' looks like film directing in a clue about screenplays, but here it is just a compass point.
explanation.definitionFit: Screenplays are the written texts of films, the documents actors learn their lines from.

clue.text: The objective is prison reform centrally

indicators.note: to reform the centre is to rearrange only the middle letters of the prison word, here swapping its two inner letters

parts.note: gaol is the British spelling of jail, a prison

explanation.surface: A statement that the aim of the justice system is reforming its prisons.
explanation.walkthrough: GAOL (British spelling of jail) has its middle pair A and O swapped, as 'reform centrally' instructs, giving the target word.
explanation.definitionFit: An objective is an aim or target that someone strives to reach.

clue.text: Disturb females accepted by decree

indicators.note: something accepted by another is taken inside it, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a decree is a rule laid down by authority
F is the abbreviation for female, doubled for the plural

explanation.surface: A decree that has been accepted by women causes upset.
explanation.walkthrough: FF (females, as in the plural abbreviation ff) goes inside RULE.
explanation.definitionFit: To disturb something is to ruffle it, as wind disarranges hair or calm water.

clue.text: Check around eight for bottles of this type

indicators.note: around means the check word is wrapped about the other piece

parts.note: to check something is to stop it
a rowing eight is a boat's crew of eight oarsmen

explanation.surface: Someone checking up on eight bottles of a particular type.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eight' is not a number here: in rowing an eight is the boat's team of oarsmen.
explanation.definitionFit: Many wine and soft-drink bottles have a threaded cap twisted on and off rather than a cork.

clue.text: One toys with new diet at lent

indicators.note: new suggests a fresh form, so the letters of diet, at and lent are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone toying with a new diet during Lent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One toys with' reads like part of the sentence, but it is the definition: a dabbler only plays at things.
explanation.definitionFit: A dabbler only plays at an art or subject, toying with it without serious commitment.

clue.text: Hopping, enraged — yes, enraged

indicators.note: hopping suggests jumping about, so the letters of the first enraged move around

explanation.surface: A furious exclamation insisting someone is hopping mad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hopping' looks like 'hopping mad', the definition, but it is the signal that rearranges the first 'enraged'; the second 'enraged' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone enraged is furious, made cross by something.

clue.text: After a month's work, one is well armed and in depth

definitions.text: one is well armed and in depth

indicators.note: after says the work piece comes behind the month piece

parts.note: Oct is the abbreviation for October, a month
an opus is a musical or literary work

explanation.surface: After a month of labour, someone is well equipped and deeply involved.
explanation.walkthrough: 'well armed' plays on the creature's eight arms, and 'in depth' places it in the deep sea.
explanation.definitionFit: The sea creature with eight arms lives in the ocean depths, hence well armed and down deep.

clue.text: Things accomplished in lawsuits

definitions.meaning: deeds or acts that have been carried out

explanation.surface: Achievements gained through litigation.
explanation.definitionFit: Deeds are things done, and a court case is also called this; both senses fit the same word.

clue.text: A Libyan snob manipulates old people

indicators.note: to manipulate is to handle and rework, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A snobbish Libyan exploiting others.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient inhabitants of a Mesopotamian city-state are a historical, long-gone nation.

clue.text: Menu written on train ticket?

definitions.meaning: playfully, a bill is something written and the fare is the price on a train ticket

explanation.surface: A menu printed on the back of a railway ticket.
explanation.definitionFit: An old-fashioned name for a restaurant menu, which also reads whimsically as a statement of travel cost.

clue.text: Nest found on English garden

indicators.note: in an across answer, a piece found on another follows it

parts.note: a den is a lair or nest

explanation.surface: A nest discovered in an English garden.
explanation.walkthrough: In an across clue, 'found on' puts DEN after E.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical paradise was the garden where Adam and Eve lived.

clue.text: Plan great changes in animal enclosure

indicators.note: in places the rearranged letters inside the pen

parts.note: a sty is a pen for pigs

indicators.note: changes means the word great is altered into a new order

explanation.surface: A scheme to make big alterations to a zoo pen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'great' looks like an adjective for the changes, but it is the word being rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A plan of action devised to achieve a goal is a strategy.

clue.text: Vehicle protected by a time shield, say — that's innovative

indicators.note: something protected by another is surrounded by it

parts.note: a van is a vehicle

indicators.note: say signals that the shield word is to be heard rather than spelt

parts.note: to shield is to guard

explanation.surface: A vehicle kept safe for a time by some sort of shield is a new idea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' means the second half is a soundalike; the French spelling of the shield word is the one entered.
explanation.definitionFit: Pioneering, experimental art or ideas ahead of their time are described by this French-derived term.

clue.text: Championships given TV credits

definitions.meaning: names shown on screen at the start or end of a programme

explanation.surface: Sporting champions being named in the closing credits of a television show.
explanation.definitionFit: A champion holds a sporting crown, and the on-screen credits listing names are also so called.

clue.text: Separate actors by role played

parts.note: the role an actor plays is a part
a theatrical company is a troupe of actors

explanation.surface: Dividing a troupe of performers according to the characters they play.
explanation.definitionFit: To go separate ways is to leave each other, a common idiom.

clue.text: Player not on pitch — why?

parts.note: pitch means musical pitch, not a sports field: a musician who cannot keep in tune may lack the ear for it

explanation.surface: A footballer left off the field, and the question of why.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone unable to hear differences in musical pitch plays out of tune.

clue.text: Madman nearly finished meal, eating at one

indicators.note: eating means the meal piece takes in the other letters
nearly finished means the meal word loses its final letter

parts.note: lunch is a midday meal
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A crazy diner who has almost finished eating at one o'clock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eating' reads as the diner eating lunch, but it is the signal that the shortened meal swallows the other letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A deranged person is a madman, from the old idea that the moon caused insanity.

clue.text: Are you French? A case of rarely spoken English

parts.note: es-tu is French for are you

indicators.note: the case of a word is its outer shell, its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Someone asking a French speaker a question about a rarely heard variety of English.
explanation.walkthrough: ESTU is French for 'are you'; 'case of' gives the first and last letters of rarely, R and Y. Estuary English is the accent of London and the Thames estuary area.
explanation.definitionFit: The south-east English accent of the Thames area is a recognised variety of the spoken language.

clue.text: No backing for dog meat

parts.note: a mutt is a mongrel dog

indicators.note: backing means the word no is read backwards

explanation.surface: A refusal to give a dog any meat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No backing' reads as a refusal of support, but it is the word no turned round.
explanation.definitionFit: Meat from a grown sheep is sold under this name.

clue.text: Step up home credit relief

parts.note: in means at home
CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit
ease is relief from pain or trouble

explanation.surface: Advice to boost tax relief on home loans.
explanation.definitionFit: To step up output is to raise it, making it larger.

clue.text: Where gambling is a wicked thing in company

indicators.note: in places the wicked act inside the company abbreviation

parts.note: a sin is a wicked act

explanation.surface: A remark that betting is a sinful activity when done in company.
explanation.definitionFit: A gaming house is the venue where roulette, cards and other betting take place.

clue.text: People who might precede American leader

indicators.note: precede puts the might word in front of the other piece

parts.note: may expresses possibility, what someone might do

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A group who could come before an American head of state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leader' gives the first letter of American, A, which MAY precedes. The Maya are an indigenous people of Central America.
explanation.definitionFit: A Mesoamerican civilisation and its present-day descendants are a nation or people.

clue.text: Cheese enjoyed by a Scandinavian sportsman?

definitions.meaning: a soft veined cheese from Denmark
a blue is an award to a university athlete, so a Dane could hold such an honour

explanation.surface: A cheese savoured by a Nordic athlete.
explanation.walkthrough: At Oxford and Cambridge a sportsman who represents the university is awarded a blue.
explanation.definitionFit: A blue-veined Danish cheese, and whimsically a Danish athlete's university honour.

clue.text: One may be passed by this young man

definitions.text: One may be passed by this
definitions.meaning: the idiom pass the ..., shifting responsibility on
a lively young fellow, especially a dashing one

explanation.surface: A young fellow who can be overtaken.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom of shifting responsibility uses this word, also an old term for a spirited young man.

clue.text: Talkative person has part of the bagpipes

definitions.meaning: someone who talks at tedious length
the air reservoir of the bagpipes that the player blows into

explanation.surface: A chatterbox who plays the bagpipes.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-winded talker is so called, and the pipes' air reservoir carries the same name.

clue.text: Strange animal one found in a French cereal

indicators.note: found in places the one letter within the other pieces

parts.note: un is French for a
corn is a cereal crop
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A peculiar creature discovered in a French cornfield.
explanation.walkthrough: UN is the French masculine form of 'a', a common crossword convention.
explanation.definitionFit: The mythical one-horned horse is a fabulous creature.
